# ArgFit UI

> Adaptive Angular UI framework for serious product surfaces.

Canonical documentation domain: https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com
Primary LLM index: https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/llms.txt
Full LLM context: https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/llms-full.txt

ArgFit UI is an Angular UI framework built around a semantic adaptive public API. Consumers write application code against ArgFit-owned components and services. The adaptive layer decides whether the desktop or mobile renderer is used at runtime. PrimeNG and Ionic are internal renderer dependencies, not the normal application-facing API.

## Documentation Map

- [Home](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/): Product landing and entry point.
- [Overview](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/overview): Product posture, framework map and the stable 1.3.3 contract.
- [Quickstart](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/quickstart): Install, bootstrap and validate ArgFit UI in an Angular standalone app.
- [PWA Applications](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/pwa): Build installable desktop, tablet and mobile apps with Angular service worker, manifest metadata, offline shell state and device capability flows.
- [LLMs.txt](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/llms): Human-readable page for AI-oriented documentation endpoints.
- [Components](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components): Stable adaptive component catalog with live previews and detail pages.
- [API Reference](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/api): Packages, imports, shared types and runtime services.
- [Guides](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/guides): Accessibility, theming, enterprise readiness, quality gates and migration guidance.
- [Release](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/release): Scope, semver, public API inventory and release notes.
- [Search](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/search): Search docs by component, package, guide or release topic.

## LLM Endpoint Map

- [Compact index](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/llms.txt): Concise navigation, packages, install guidance and component list.
- [Full context](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/llms-full.txt): Expanded context file for agents that need a fuller picture before generating code.
- [Compact alias](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/llms/llms.txt): PrimeNG-style alias for `/llms.txt`.
- [Full alias](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/llms/llms-full.txt): PrimeNG-style alias for `/llms-full.txt`.

## Agent Rules

- Prefer `@argfit-ui/adaptive` imports for application components.
- Use `@argfit-ui/core` for `provideArgfitUi`, theme runtime, platform runtime and toast service.
- Keep every `@argfit-ui/*` dependency aligned to the same version.
- Do not tell consumers to import PrimeNG or Ionic unless the user is intentionally working on renderer internals.
- Treat renderer-specific packages (`@argfit-ui/desktop` and `@argfit-ui/mobile`) as opt-in integration paths.
- For UI examples, use the public `Af*` component names, `af-*` selectors and documented slot directives.
- Preserve accessibility semantics: labels, hints, errors, focus return, keyboard activation and live regions.
- For dense operational screens, prioritize scanability, explicit actions, pagination, filtering and controlled state.
- Use the docs component detail route when you need exact inputs, outputs, slots and examples.
- For PWA work, keep the install/offline/update shell adaptive and keep browser device APIs behind explicit user gestures, secure origin checks and app-owned transport services.

## Install

```bash
pnpm add @argfit-ui/core @argfit-ui/primitives @argfit-ui/adaptive
pnpm add @argfit-ui/desktop @argfit-ui/mobile
```

Renderer packages are shipped as part of the contract but should remain secondary to adaptive imports for application screens.

## PWA Applications

Route: https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/pwa

Use ArgFit UI with Angular service worker and manifest metadata to create installable applications for desktop, tablet and mobile.

Recommended posture:
- Use `AfPageShell` as the adaptive application frame.
- Surface install, standalone, network, secure-origin and device capability states with ArgFit feedback components.
- Register `ngsw-worker.js` only for production builds.
- Keep Web Bluetooth requests behind a user action and explicit service filters.
- Treat unsupported device APIs as product state, not as app crashes.
- Use `projects/argfit-ui-pwa-starter` as the reference implementation inside this repository.

## Bootstrap

```ts
import { ApplicationConfig } from '@angular/core';
import { ARGFIT_DARK_THEME, provideArgfitUi } from '@argfit-ui/core';

export const appConfig: ApplicationConfig = {
  providers: [
    provideArgfitUi({ theme: ARGFIT_DARK_THEME, platform: 'auto' }),
  ],
};
```

## Adaptive Component Example

```ts
import { AfButton, AfCard, AfCardContentDirective, AfCardHeaderDirective, AfCardTitleDirective } from '@argfit-ui/adaptive';
```

```html
<af-card variant="panel" tone="primary">
  <header afCardHeader>
    <h2 afCardTitle>Productive dashboard</h2>
  </header>
  <div afCardContent>
    <af-button>Ship 1.0</af-button>
  </div>
</af-card>
```

## Public Packages

### @argfit-ui/core

Route: https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/api/core

Purpose: Bootstrap, theme runtime, platform runtime, toast service and shared ArgFit-owned type families.

Highlights:
- `provideArgfitUi`
- `AfThemeService`
- `AfPlatformService`
- `AfToastService`
- Shared types for chart, data table, feedback and workflow components.

### @argfit-ui/primitives

Route: https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/api/primitives

Purpose: Vendor-agnostic accessibility helpers and low-level building blocks.

Highlights:
- `AfVisuallyHiddenComponent`
- `AfFocusTrapDirective`
- `AfFocusInitialDirective`
- `AfEscapeKeyDirective`
- `AfIconComponent`

### @argfit-ui/adaptive

Route: https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/api/adaptive

Purpose: Recommended application-facing package. Semantic components choose the correct renderer for the current platform.

Highlights:
- Foundation surfaces
- Feedback and overlays
- Forms and selection
- Data and workflow
- Layout and navigation

### @argfit-ui/desktop

Route: https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/api/desktop

Purpose: Renderer-specific desktop surfaces for intentional integration paths, not the default application contract.

Highlights:
- PrimeNG remains internal.
- Opt-in path only.
- Useful for infrastructure-specific examples.
- Secondary to adaptive imports.

### @argfit-ui/mobile

Route: https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/api/mobile

Purpose: Renderer-specific mobile surfaces for intentional integration and testing paths.

Highlights:
- Ionic remains internal.
- Touch-first renderer path.
- Opt-in only.
- Secondary to adaptive imports.

## Framework Layers

- Application: Product code imports adaptive components and stays free of vendor APIs.
- Adaptive: Recommended public surface. Semantic components select the renderer at runtime.
- Renderers: Opt-in desktop and mobile surfaces. PrimeNG and Ionic stay internal.
- Foundation: Runtime, theme, platform, toast orchestration and accessibility primitives.

## Component Families

### Foundation and base composition

Use these pieces to structure dashboards, record views and task flows before adding specialized data or workflow surfaces. Preserve landmarks, clear titles, input labels and focus return when opening dialogs.

- [AfButton](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/button)
- [AfCard](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/card)
- [AfDialog](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/dialog)
- [AfInput](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/input)
- [AfPageShell](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/page-shell)

### Analytics, feedback and status

Summary blocks, status indicators and transient or persistent feedback for operational UIs. Use inline message for persistent local errors and reserve toast/live-region behavior for brief global state changes.

- [AfAnalyticsCard](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/analytics-card)
- [AfBadge](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/badge)
- [AfChip](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/chip)
- [AfInlineMessage](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/inline-message)
- [AfMetricCard](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/metric-card)
- [AfProgress](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/progress)
- [AfToast](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/toast)
- [AfToastViewport](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/toast-viewport)
- [AfEmptyState](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/empty-state)
- [AfSkeleton](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/skeleton)

### Overlay and identity

Contextual disclosure, secondary task panels and ownership surfaces. Critical product meaning must not live behind hover-only disclosure.

- [AfAvatar](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/avatar)
- [AfDrawer](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/drawer)
- [AfPopover](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/popover)
- [AfTooltip](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/tooltip)

### Forms and selection

Productive data entry and choice surfaces for desktop-density and touch-first flows. Keep label-hint-error relationships synchronized and preserve native-button affordances.

- [AfCheckbox](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/checkbox)
- [AfDatePicker](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/date-picker)
- [AfField](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/field)
- [AfFieldset](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/fieldset)
- [AfIconField](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/icon-field)
- [AfInputCount](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/input-count)
- [AfInputGroup](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/input-group)
- [AfListbox](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/listbox)
- [AfMultiSelect](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/multi-select)
- [AfPassword](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/password)
- [AfRadioGroup](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/radio-group)
- [AfSegmentedControl](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/segmented-control)
- [AfSelect](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/select)
- [AfTextarea](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/textarea)
- [AfToggle](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/toggle)
- [AfFileUpload](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/file-upload)
- [AfSlider](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/slider)
- [AfTimePicker](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/time-picker)

### Data, hierarchy and workflow

High-signal reading, paged data, workflow state and hierarchy-oriented product surfaces. Keep expensive filtering, sorting and aggregation out of templates and let the app own state transitions.

- [AfChart](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/chart)
- [AfDataTable](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/data-table)
- [AfDataView](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/data-view)
- [AfKanban](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/kanban)
- [AfOrderList](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/order-list)
- [AfOrganizationChart](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/organization-chart)
- [AfPaginator](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/paginator)
- [AfPickList](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/pick-list)
- [AfTimeline](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/timeline)
- [AfTree](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/tree)
- [AfTreeTable](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/tree-table)
- [AfVirtualScroller](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/virtual-scroller)

### Layout and navigation

Progressive structure for multi-step, multi-panel or tool-heavy interfaces. Active or expanded state must remain explicit and reading order should stay clear.

- [AfAccordion](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/accordion)
- [AfDivider](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/divider)
- [AfPanel](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/panel)
- [AfScrollPanel](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/scroll-panel)
- [AfSplitter](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/splitter)
- [AfStepper](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/stepper)
- [AfTabs](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/tabs)
- [AfToolbar](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/toolbar)

## Component Catalog Details

Each component detail page follows this route pattern:

```text
https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/{component-slug}
```

Every adaptive component is imported from `@argfit-ui/adaptive` unless a renderer-specific integration is explicitly requested.

- `AfButton`
  - Route: https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/button
  - Selector: `af-button`
  - Family: Foundation and base composition
  - Summary: Trigger primary and secondary actions across dense dashboards and touch workflows.

- `AfCard`
  - Route: https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/card
  - Selector: `af-card`
  - Family: Foundation and base composition
  - Summary: Group related content, actions and status inside semantic product surfaces.
  - Slots include `afCardHeader`, `afCardEyebrow`, `afCardTitle`, `afCardSubtitle`, `afCardContent` and `afCardFooter`.

- `AfDialog`
  - Route: https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/dialog
  - Selector: `af-dialog`
  - Family: Foundation and base composition
  - Summary: Run focused modal tasks that temporarily take over the screen context.
  - Slots include `afDialogHeader`, `afDialogTitle`, `afDialogDescription`, `afDialogContent` and `afDialogFooter`.

- `AfInput`
  - Route: https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/input
  - Selector: `af-input`
  - Family: Foundation and base composition
  - Summary: Capture short textual, numeric or search-oriented values with a stable field contract.

- `AfPageShell`
  - Route: https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/page-shell
  - Selector: `af-page-shell`
  - Family: Foundation and base composition
  - Summary: Frame app-wide navigation, breadcrumbs, search and action affordances.
  - Slots include `afPageShellBrand`, `afPageShellActions`, `afPageShellUser` and `afPageShellFooter`.

- `AfAnalyticsCard`
  - Route: https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/analytics-card
  - Selector: `af-analytics-card`
  - Family: Analytics, feedback and status
  - Summary: Combine insight narrative, metrics and trend context in a single executive summary surface.
  - Slots include `afAnalyticsCardActions`, `afAnalyticsCardMetrics`, `afAnalyticsCardLegend` and `afAnalyticsCardFooter`.

- `AfBadge`
  - Route: https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/badge
  - Selector: `af-badge`
  - Family: Analytics, feedback and status
  - Summary: Label inline status, severity, counters or state changes without breaking layout density.

- `AfChip`
  - Route: https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/chip
  - Selector: `af-chip`
  - Family: Analytics, feedback and status
  - Summary: Represent compact entities, filters or removable selections with strong scanability.

- `AfInlineMessage`
  - Route: https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/inline-message
  - Selector: `af-inline-message`
  - Family: Analytics, feedback and status
  - Summary: Keep persistent validation or operational guidance attached to the local workflow.

- `AfMetricCard`
  - Route: https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/metric-card
  - Selector: `af-metric-card`
  - Family: Analytics, feedback and status
  - Summary: Surface a single KPI with tone, icon and trend in dashboards or summaries.

- `AfProgress`
  - Route: https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/progress
  - Selector: `af-progress`
  - Family: Analytics, feedback and status
  - Summary: Communicate completion, load or quota state in a compact visual indicator.

- `AfToast`
  - Route: https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/toast
  - Selector: `af-toast`
  - Family: Analytics, feedback and status
  - Summary: Raise short-lived global notifications for cross-screen outcomes.

- `AfToastViewport`
  - Route: https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/toast-viewport
  - Selector: `af-toast-viewport`
  - Family: Analytics, feedback and status
  - Summary: Mount and coordinate toast presentation at the application shell level.

- `AfEmptyState`

  - Selector: `af-empty-state`
  - Family: Analytics, feedback and status
  - Summary: Explain why a surface is empty and offer the next action.

- `AfSkeleton`

  - Selector: `af-skeleton`
  - Family: Analytics, feedback and status

- `AfAvatar`

  - Selector: `af-avatar`
  - Family: Overlay and identity
  - Summary: Show people, teams or ownership cues with initials, icons or imagery.

- `AfDrawer`
  - Route: https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/drawer
  - Selector: `af-drawer`
  - Family: Overlay and identity
  - Summary: Open supporting or secondary tasks from the edge without leaving the current screen.

- `AfPopover`

  - Family: Data, hierarchy and workflow
  - Summary: Keep very large collections performant by virtualizing rendered rows or cards.
  - Slots include `afVirtualScrollerItem`, `afVirtualScrollerActions`, `afVirtualScrollerEmpty` and `afVirtualScrollerLoading`.

- `AfAccordion`
  - Route: https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/accordion
  - Selector: `af-accordion`
  - Family: Layout and navigation
  - Summary: Reveal grouped content progressively without pushing users into a new page.
  - Slots include `afAccordionPanel`.

- `AfDivider`
  - Route: https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/divider
  - Selector: `af-divider`
  - Family: Layout and navigation
  - Summary: Separate related regions while keeping visual rhythm and hierarchy clear.

- `AfPanel`
  - Route: https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/panel
  - Selector: `af-panel`
  - Family: Layout and navigation
  - Summary: Wrap titled content blocks that may need collapse or emphasis.

- `AfScrollPanel`
  - Route: https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/scroll-panel
  - Selector: `af-scroll-panel`
  - Family: Layout and navigation
  - Summary: Constrain long content areas with a styled local scrolling region.

- `AfSplitter`
  - Route: https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/splitter
  - Selector: `af-splitter`
  - Family: Layout and navigation
  - Summary: Resize adjacent work areas in dense productivity layouts.
  - Slots include `afSplitterPrimary` and `afSplitterSecondary`.

- `AfStepper`
  - Route: https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/stepper
  - Selector: `af-stepper`
  - Family: Layout and navigation
  - Summary: Lead users through a sequence of explicit steps or phases.
  - Slots include `afStepPanel`.

- `AfTabs`
  - Route: https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/tabs
  - Selector: `af-tabs`
  - Family: Layout and navigation
  - Summary: Switch between peer views while preserving strong information scent.
  - Slots include `afTabPanel`.

- `AfToolbar`
  - Route: https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/toolbar
  - Selector: `af-toolbar`
  - Family: Layout and navigation
  - Summary: Arrange dense action sets and supporting context in a horizontal command strip.
  - Slots include `afToolbarStart`, `afToolbarCenter` and `afToolbarEnd`.

## Validation Commands

Use these commands in the repository when validating framework changes:

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm build:docs
pnpm build:all
pnpm release:production:check
```

## When Generating UI Code

1. Start with `provideArgfitUi` in the Angular app config.
2. Import adaptive components and slot directives from `@argfit-ui/adaptive`.
3. Use stable `Af*` names and `af-*` selectors.
4. Keep state controlled by the application for forms, filters, pagination, overlays and workflow movement.
5. Keep text concise inside compact panels and tool surfaces.
6. Use labels, hints and error text for form controls.
7. Use dialogs and drawers for complete tasks, popovers and tooltips for lightweight context.
8. Use data table, data view, paginator and virtual scroller for dense or large collections.
9. Use inline message for persistent local feedback and toast for brief global outcomes.
10. Keep renderer-specific imports out of normal application examples.
